title: Nacho Flow Configuration
description: Nacho Flow runtime configuration schema for profile*.yaml and config.yaml

port.description: Port on which the Nacho Flow model gateway listens

admin_port.description: Port on which the Nacho Flow admin and telemetry API listens

host.description: Network bind interface address (default: 127.0.0.1 for local isolation, 0.0.0.0 for LAN access)

providers.description: Upstream LLM providers (local llama-server, vLLM, Ollama, OpenRouter, Anthropic)

local.description: Flag indicating if the provider is a locally running model server (only valid for openai_compatible)

base_url.description: HTTP/HTTPS base URL endpoint of the upstream provider

api_key.description: Optional API authentication key or environment variable reference

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for inference requests

max_retries.description: Maximum number of automatic retry attempts on network or upstream failures

context_window.description: Maximum context window capacity in tokens

cost_per_input_token.description: Cost per million or per input token in USD

cost_per_output_token.description: Cost per million or per output token in USD

wire_format.description: Wire protocol format expected by the provider

tiers.description: Waterfall routing tiers evaluated sequentially from top to bottom (first match wins)

name.description: Unique descriptive identifier for this tier

provider.description: ID of the provider defined under 'providers:'

model.description: Upstream model ID to dispatch to

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort budget passed to reasoning models

strip_images.description: Strip base64 images from conversation history to preserve context tokens

has_vision.description: Explicit declaration whether model supports vision/images

strip_tools.description: Strip tool schemas and function call history from request

has_tools.description: Explicit declaration whether model supports function/tool calling

max_context.description: Maximum context window allocated for this tier

raw.description: Pass request through unmutated without normalizers or rewriting

shield.description: Tier-level Agentic Tool Fallback Shield toggle

normalizer.description: Tier-level toggle for response stream normalizer

thought_slap.description: Reasoning truncation loop defense and recovery tier

default_tier.description: Fallback catch-all tier when no waterfall tier 'when' conditions evaluate to true

kickstart.description: Cross-turn idle loop and reasoning limit defense

normalizers.description: Selective tool and stream normalizer strategies

deals.description: Heatseeker live model deals engine monitoring spot prices and discounts

enabled.description: Master toggle for live model deal discovery and alerts

alert_threshold_pct.description: Minimum discount percentage required to alert or recommend a deal (e.g. 30.0%)

min_coding_index.description: Minimum benchmark coding index required for deal eligibility (e.g. 40.0)

require_tools.description: Exclude deals for models that do not declare tool-calling capabilities

agent_shield.description: Agentic Tool Fallback Shield catching runaway agent loops and errors

enabled.description: Master switch for agent shield runtime defense

tail_buffer_bytes.description: Rolling byte window inspected for error signatures and loop patterns

question_heuristics.description: Regex patterns detecting redundant question loops

mode_switch_heuristics.description: Regex patterns detecting unexpected mode switches

error_signatures.description: Signatures indicating unrecoverable CLI/tool error loops

nts.description: Neural Token Saver (NTS) in-place prompt compaction engine

enabled.description: Master switch for tool output compaction and token savings

strip_ansi.description: Pass 1: Strip ANSI and OSC terminal escape sequences

resolve_cr.description: Pass 2: Overwrite carriage returns from progress spinners

deduplicate_lines.description: Strip consecutive duplicate lines from tool and terminal outputs

dedup_threshold.description: Line count threshold triggering line deduplication

strip_boilerplate.description: Strip common CLI and test boilerplate headers

preserve_cache_control.description: Dual-lane immunity for prompt cache breakpoints

strip_historical_reasoning.description: Prune older assistant reasoning/thoughts from prior turns

keep_recent_reasoning_turns.description: Keep the N most recent assistant turns intact to prevent amnesia

reminders_refresh_interval.description: Re-emit full reminders table every N turns

collapse_verbose_tests.description: Multi-language test output collapse (Go, Cargo, Pytest, Jest)

deduplicate_tool_outputs.description: Deduplicate identical generic tool outputs (>200 B)

min_duplicate_output_bytes.description: Minimum output length in bytes for duplicate referencing

compact_stale_file_reads.description: Compact older file reads when the same file is read again

stale_read_depth.description: Depth of turns before an unreferenced read is compacted

cycleBreakerConfig.description: In-flight stream defense that murders infinite loops & monologue traps in <3s

enabled.description: Master switch for all in-flight stream defense

phrase_length.description: Default sliding n-gram window size (words) across lanes

budget_max_repeats.description: Default repeat threshold once lane token budget is exceeded

model_cooldown_seconds.description: Skip cycle-killed model on this session for 2m

retry_floor.description: Minimum retry floor before cloud escalation

max_retries.description: Stage 1 local retries with [SYSTEM OVERRIDE] before cloud escalation

correction_prompt.description: System correction injected into the stream to nudge the agent out of the loop

max_content_tokens.description: Maximum allowed tokens in content lane

max_thinking_tokens.description: Maximum allowed tokens in reasoning/thinking lane

max_tool_tokens.description: Maximum allowed tokens in tool lane

max_write_tokens.description: Maximum allowed tokens in file write tool operations

repetition_window.description: Sliding token window examined for repeated phrases

repetition_threshold.description: Threshold count of repeats triggering stream break

thinking_repetition_threshold.description: Threshold count of repeats in reasoning lane

budget_repetition_threshold.description: Threshold count of repeats allowed under cooperative budget

thinking_budget_repetition_threshold.description: Threshold count of repeats in reasoning lane under budget

laneConfig.description: Stream lane repetition and loop defense configuration

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens allowed in lane stream before intervention

phrase_length.description: Sliding n-gram window size for this lane

max_repeats.description: Max identical repeats before stream termination

budget_max_repeats.description: Max repeats allowed under cooperative budget

toolLaneConfig.description: Tool argument streaming lane loop and token defense configuration

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens allowed in tool lane

phrase_length.description: Sliding n-gram window size for tool arguments

max_repeats.description: Max identical repeats in tool arguments before break

budget_max_repeats.description: Max repeats in tool arguments under cooperative budget

max_write_tokens.description: Maximum tokens permitted for file writes (default: 32768)

write_tools.description: List of tool names classified as write tools (e.g. write_to_file, apply_diff)
